Clippers have a terrible history of getting smacked at some point in the NBA Cup, if not in the first game.

2023: 18-point loss at Dallas (first game)
2024: 21-point loss at Houston (first game)
2025: 17-point loss at Los Angeles (third game)
2026: 26-point loss at Minnesota (tonight)

record.text: The Clippers have cut a double-digit lead down to single digits 12 times tonight. Minnesota scored on the *VERY NEXT* possession 11 of those times to push it back to double digits.

Clippers ran a curl action for Garland out of a timeout for Dunn to find him; second ATO that Clippers scored off of that action. Minnesota responded with an 8-0 run that doubled their lead to 106-90 with 7:21 left to play. Only one timeout left for Clippers.
Clippers scored multiple times on ATOs where Garland curls around screens and Dunn finds him for a cut bucket

Clippers came into tonight allowing 1.330 points per turnover to opponents, the second-highest mark in the league (Golden State, 1.333). They’re allowing 1.429 tonight to Minnesota. They came in leading the league in turnovers per game, so this is just doubly harmful.
